description.en: Genus-level whole living colony with inhabitants concealed within a biserial housing, informed by Diplograptus pristis. Nominal size, depth, simplified repeated thecae, completed ends, warm brown palette and upright pose are artistic; no specimen splicing or complete soft-anatomy claim.
description.zh: 属级完整活体群体解释，生物体隐藏在双列胞管内；尺寸、深度、简化重复胞管、端部补全、棕色与直立姿态为创作，不拼接标本或宣称完整软组织复原。
